content.what_it_is: MATLAB bathymetry-plotting script: it loads a 30-minute depth grid (L2), derives longitude/latitude coordinate vectors from its dimensions and fixed half-degree spacing/origins (L4-L8), then plots negated depth with interpolated pcolor shading and a DEM colormap (L16-L17).
entities: depth matrix dep loaded at L2
matrix dimensions n and m defined at L4
grid spacings dx and dy defined at L5-L6
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L7-L8
figure dimensions wid and len defined at L11-L12

equations.ref: plot negated depth on derived coordinates

unresolved: Potential cross-line sign mismatch at L16-L17: the plotted CData is -dep, but demcmap is configured from dep; whether the resulting color limits/colors describe the displayed sign correctly depends on the input convention and demcmap behavior, neither documented here.
MATLAB pcolor at L16 ordinarily renders cells between vertices and therefore omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces; the script does not compensate if full-grid coverage is intended.
